_readme: The page's own presentation data, keyed by video id. Not the Channel Manager's: it owns channels.json only. Cast and credits name only people who pass the publication gate (verified and public in the registry) or are credited as on the video itself, and a role is only what the film's own title card or its posted YouTube description says; nobody is paired with an instrument or a job the sources do not pair them with. Chapters are the ones posted on YouTube: a title with no posted chapters has none. No biography is written here. A label (such as New) carries a label_until date after which the page stops showing it.
